title: Purair® FLEX Portable Glove Bags for Pharmaceutical, Forensic, and Industrial Applications
meta_title: Purair FLEX Portable Glove Bags - Flexible Isolators for Containment
meta_description: The Purair FLEX is a portable, cost-effective flexible film isolator with a large work area, easy setup, and safety features for pharmaceutical, forensic, and industrial applications.
meta_keywords: purair flex, portable glove bags, flexible isolators, pharmaceutical containment, forensic processing, industrial cleaning
short_description: Air Science provides containment solutions to meet any analytical need. The Purair® FLEX glove bag is a portable, cost-effective flexible film isolator with more volume, easy setup and safety options.
full_description: Compliant with Multiple Criteria. ArmorFlex film complies with FDA 21CFR and 2002/72/EC standards for minimal outgassing, solvent and biological reactivity and static resistance. Pharmaceutical Grade Materials. The Purair FLEX is constructed with FDA approved pharmaceutical grade LLDPE anti-static and ESD safe and meets European ATEX Directive. Large Workspace. At 30" (762 mm) wide and an internal volume of 3 cu.ft. (85 L) the Purair FLEX provides a large work area with a 12.5" (317 mm) gas tight zippered access with a 6" (152 mm) diameter opening. Oxygen-free Work Zone. A nitrogen gas barb is a standard feature to permit creation of an oxygen-free workspace.
seo_content: The Purair FLEX portable glove bag is designed for a wide range of applications, including pharmaceutical processing, forensic investigation and processing, industrial cleaning, biological containment, and aerospace. Its large work area, easy setup, and safety features make it a versatile and effective containment solution for various analytical and processing needs.
features_data: Nitrogen gas barb for oxygen-free workspace
